description:
Core no longer contains Sphinx or the site (#3096); benchbox.dev is built in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site. A few core references to the Sphinx layout remain (checked against origin/develop on 2026-10-30):

- scripts/comment_syntax.py (around lines 175-176) keeps a docs/_templates HTML adapter. Its tests are in tests/unit/scripts/test_comment_policy.py (around lines 3866-3880 and 4134), with matching entries in the medium shard durations file.
- tests/unit/scripts/test_path_filter_decision.py (around lines 257-290) uses docs/_extensions/sphinx_tags_fix.py and other Sphinx paths that no longer exist; replace them with paths that exist.
- docs/internal/benchbox-results-platform-strategy.md (around line 631) sketches the Sphinx pipeline; correct it.
- _project/decisions/adr-astro-unified-site.md needs a note that docs/internal/adr/adr-site-repo-split.md partly supersedes it. Its link around line 203, _project/decisions/astro-api-reference-contract.md around line 189 and _project/decisions/astro-parity-signoff.md around lines 24 and 31 point at a directory that no longer exists; re-point them (for example to the copy of api-reference-url-map.json in benchbox-site inventory/) or mark them historical.

docs/linkcheck_ignore.txt (deleted by #3659), make/documentation.mk and pyproject.toml are already clean. Out of scope: make/monolith-baseline.json (frozen history) and landing/prompts/catalog.yaml (the bundle's catalog source).
